calculation.expression: (-rolling_sum(pct_change(close)-cross_sectional_mean(pct_change(close)),5) / (rolling_std(pct_change(close),20)*sqrt(20))) * (1.0 if (DXY > median(DXY,60) or VIX > median(VIX,60)) else -0.35), then cross-sectional median residualization and one-day lag
calculation.description: Ranks five-day asset-specific residual losses positively for reversal during elevated DXY or VIX regimes, while applying a smaller trend-following coefficient in benign regimes. Volatility scaling, cross-sectional residualization, and one-day lag reduce common-market and look-ahead effects.

parameters.stress_rule: DXY above 60-day median OR VIX above 60-day median

validation.regime_notes: H10 IC remained positive in 2027-2030 (0.02486) and 2031-2034 (0.02428), but weakened in 2035 YTD (0.00173). The 15-asset universe and 44.0% signal coverage require conservative interpretation; stress activation occurred on 70.1% of dates.
